Street Medic: Patched up the Quiet Mile for food and favours.
街头医生: 在静谧一英里给人缝伤口，换口饭吃，换点人情。

Street Medic: Integrity regenerates (2.5 per second) once you have gone 4 seconds without taking damage
街头医生: 连续4秒未受伤后，完整度会持续恢复（每秒2.5点）
医疗包恢复50点完整度，而不是35点
创伤急救包恢复75%，而不是60%

Street Medic: Before the erasure you ran a folding table under the Quiet Mile overpass: stitches for noodles, antibiotics for battery cells, no questions for anyone. Couriers, gangers and Helix guards on their day off all lay on the same bloodstained tarp.
街头医生: 在你被抹除之前，你在静谧一英里的高架桥下支着一张折叠桌：缝针换面条，抗生素换电池，对谁都不多问。信使、帮派分子和休班的螺旋保安，都躺过同一块沾满血的防水布。

Street Medic: It taught you that bodies are just machines that complain, and that most people are one bad night away from needing a stranger. You learned to stay calm with your hands inside someone else's worst moment.
街头医生: 这教会了你：身体不过是会抱怨的机器，而大多数人离需要一个陌生人帮忙，只差一个糟糕的夜晚。你学会了在别人最糟糕的时刻，把手伸进去时依然保持冷静。

Street Medic: In the field your old habits keep you alive. Your Integrity slowly regenerates (2.5 per second) once you have gone four seconds without being hit, medkits restore 50 Integrity instead of 35, and Trauma Kits heal 75% of your Integrity instead of 60%.
街头医生: 在行动中，你的老习惯让你活了下来。连续四秒没有被击中后，你的完整度会慢慢恢复（每秒2.5点）；医疗包恢复50点完整度而不是35点；创伤急救包恢复你75%的完整度，而不是60%。

Street Medic: The drawback: you were trained to put people back together, not to take them apart. Your weapon damage is reduced by 10%, and every operation where you fight instead of sneaking will feel it.
街头医生: 代价是：你受的训练是把人拼回去，而不是把人拆开。你的武器伤害降低10%，每一次选择开打而不是潜行的行动，你都会感觉到。

Street Medic: The lower districts remember the medic who never asked for a civic ID. You start with Civilian Hope +4, and people who were patched up by you are quicker to trust the stranger with no name.
街头医生: 下层街区记得那个从不要市民ID的医生。你开局获得平民希望 +4，被你救治过的人，会更快地信任这个没有名字的陌生人。

Street Medic: Wore a lanyard, smiled on cue, read the memos.
街头医生: 戴着工牌，按时微笑，读过所有备忘录。

Street Medic: Guards take 35% longer to recognise you
街头医生: 守卫认出你所需的时间延长35%

Street Medic: Helix Heat builds 25% faster once you are wanted
街头医生: 一旦被通缉，螺旋通缉度上升速度加快25%

Street Medic: You spent years as an outside contractor inside Helix Tower: badge readers, catered stand-ups, mandatory optimism seminars. You never had a real title, which made you invisible in exactly the way the company liked.
街头医生: 你在螺旋塔里当了好几年外包承包商：刷卡门禁、提供餐点的站会、强制参加的乐观主义研讨会。你从来没有正式头衔，这恰好让你以公司喜欢的方式隐形。

Street Medic: You learned the rhythm of corporate space: walk like you belong, carry a tablet, never run. You can read a security post the way other people read a menu.
街头医生: 你学会了企业空间的节奏：走路要像你属于这里，手里拿着平板，永远不要跑。你看一个安保岗位，就像别人看菜单一样。

Street Medic: Guards take 35% longer to recognise you as a threat, so you can stand in places you should not be for a few more seconds. You also know how money moves: every credit you earn is worth 20% more.
街头医生: 守卫要多花35%的时间才能把你认作威胁，所以你可以在不该待的地方多站几秒。你也懂钱是怎么流动的：你赚到的每一个信用点都多值20%。

Street Medic: The drawback: Helix still has your face on file. Once you are wanted, Helix Heat builds 25% faster, because every camera already knows what it is looking for.
街头医生: 代价是：螺旋的档案里仍然有你的脸。一旦被通缉，螺旋通缉度上升速度加快25%，因为每一台摄像头都已经知道自己在找谁。

Street Medic: You start with Corporate Leverage +5 and Raven Trust −3. Corporate contacts will speak to you like an old colleague; Raven will spend the first few chapters wondering whose side you are really on.
街头医生: 你开局获得企业筹码 +5，渡鸦信任 −3。企业的联系人会像对老同事一样跟你说话；渡鸦则会在前几章里一直怀疑你到底站在哪一边。

Street Medic: Ran getaway cars through the transit stacks.
街头医生: 在交通层之间开过逃亡车。

Street Medic: Dash recharges in 0.5 s instead of 0.8 s
街头医生: 冲刺冷却 0.5 秒，而不是 0.8 秒

Street Medic: You drove for anyone who paid in cash: smugglers, union organisers, a choir that needed to be somewhere before curfew. The transit stacks of Neon Heights were your racetrack and the city's traffic AI was your rival.
街头医生: 你给任何付现金的人开车：走私犯、工会组织者、一个必须在宵禁前赶到某处的合唱团。霓虹高地的交通层是你的赛道，城市的交通AI是你的对手。

Street Medic: Driving taught you that hesitation kills. You read gaps before they open, you commit to the line, and you never look back to see who is following.
街头医生: 开车教会了你：犹豫就是死。你在缝隙出现之前就看见它，你认准路线就不回头，也从不回头去看谁在跟着你。

Street Medic: You move 12% faster on foot, and your dash recharges in half a second instead of 0.8 seconds, so you can chain dodges and cover sprints that other people would not attempt.
街头医生: 你步行时移动速度提高12%，冲刺冷却只要半秒而不是0.8秒，所以你可以连续闪避，做出别人不敢尝试的掩体冲刺。

Street Medic: The drawback: patience was never your skill. While sneaking you move 20% slower than other couriers, so slow stealth approaches take real discipline.
街头医生: 代价是：耐心从来不是你的长处。潜行时你比其他信使慢20%，慢慢摸进去的潜行路线需要真正的自律。

Street Medic: You start with Raven Trust +3. Raven grew up around getaway drivers and recognises one; people who need to leave fast will think of you first.
街头医生: 你开局获得渡鸦信任 +3。渡鸦从小在逃亡车手身边长大，一眼就能认出同类；需要赶紧离开的人，第一个会想到你。

Street Medic: Rebuilt implants in a Gray Market stall.
街头医生: 在灰市的摊位里翻新植入体。

Street Medic: ICE BREAK sequences are one code shorter
街头医生: 破冰入侵序列少一个代码

Street Medic: Max Integrity −15 (scavenged implants your body rejects)
街头医生: 最大完整度 −15（身体排斥的拼凑植入体）

Street Medic: Your stall in the Gray Market had no sign, just a queue. You rebuilt stolen implants, unlocked firmware, and once wired a pacemaker into a vending machine because the customer could not afford better.
街头医生: 你在灰市的摊位没有招牌，只有一条长队。你翻新偷来的植入体，解锁固件，有一次还因为顾客付不起更好的，把一个心脏起搏器接进了自动售货机。

Street Medic: You learned that every system has a seam, and that the people who build machines rarely understand what they have built. Code and copper feel like one material in your hands.
街头医生: 你学到的是：每个系统都有接缝，而造机器的人很少真正理解自己造出了什么。在你手里，代码和铜线就像同一种材料。

Street Medic: ICE BREAK sequences are one code shorter for you, and your tuning of every weapon you carry adds 15% damage.
街头医生: 对你来说，破冰入侵序列少一个代码；你对随身每一件武器的调校，让伤害提高15%。

Street Medic: The drawback: you tested most of your work on yourself. Scavenged implants your body never fully accepted lower your maximum Integrity by 15.
街头医生: 代价是：你的大部分作品都是先在自己身上试的。身体从未完全接受的拼凑植入体，让你的最大完整度降低15点。

Street Medic: You start with AI Sympathy +3. Machines and the people who live through them treat you as a colleague; the Gray Market will remember the name you no longer have.
街头医生: 你开局获得AI同情 +3。机器以及靠机器生活的人会把你当作同行；灰市会记得你已经不再拥有的那个名字。

Street Medic: Trained by the private army, then discharged.
街头医生: 受过私人军队训练，然后被开除。
敌人发现你的速度加快20%

Street Medic: Nightglass took you at nineteen, drilled you for eighteen months and discharged you two weeks before your first deployment. The paperwork said "temperament". You still do not know what you did.
街头医生: 夜玻璃在你十九岁时招了你，训练了你十八个月，又在你第一次部署前两周把你开除。文件上写着“性格原因”。你至今不知道自己做错了什么。

Street Medic: They gave you the habits without the war: weapon discipline, clean reloads, the way to stand when someone might shoot. You have never fully stopped scanning rooftops.
街头医生: 他们给了你习惯，却没有给你战争：武器纪律、干净利落的装填、在可能有人开枪时该怎么站。你从来没有真正停止过扫视楼顶。

Street Medic: Recoil affects you 30% less, you reload 20% faster, and your weapon damage is 10% higher.
街头医生: 后坐力对你的影响减少30%，装填速度加快20%，武器伤害提高10%。

Street Medic: The drawback: you move like a soldier, and guards are trained to notice soldiers. Enemies detect you 20% faster.
街头医生: 代价是：你走路像个士兵，而守卫受过专门识别士兵的训练。敌人发现你的速度加快20%。

Street Medic: You start with Raven Trust +5 and Civilian Hope −2. Raven knows exactly what a Nightglass washout is and respects it; ordinary people see the posture and keep their distance.
街头医生: 你开局获得渡鸦信任 +5，平民希望 −2。渡鸦很清楚夜玻璃淘汰兵是什么，并且尊重这一点；普通人看到你的姿态，只会保持距离。

Street Medic: Carried packages nobody else would touch.
街头医生: 送过别人都不敢碰的包裹。
冲刺消耗16点能量，而不是22点

Street Medic: You take 15% more damage (you travel light, no armour)
街头医生: 受到的伤害增加15%（轻装上阵，没有护甲）

Street Medic: You worked the night routes for a dispatch office that no longer exists: sealed packages, no scanners, no questions, payment on delivery. Most nights you crossed four districts before sunrise.
街头医生: 你为一家早已不存在的调度站跑夜班路线：密封包裹，没有扫描仪，不问问题，货到付款。大多数夜晚，你在日出前要穿过四个街区。

Street Medic: Speed became the way you think. You know which stairwells connect, which rooftops hold your weight, and how long a door stays open after a security guard yawns.
街头医生: 速度成了你思考的方式。你知道哪些楼梯间是相通的，哪些楼顶撑得住你的体重，以及保安打哈欠之后，一扇门会开多久。

Street Medic: Your maximum Energy is 30 higher and your dash costs 16 Energy instead of 22, so you can keep moving long after other people stop to breathe.
街头医生: 你的最大能量提高30点，冲刺消耗16点能量而不是22点，所以别人停下来喘气的时候，你还能一直跑。

Street Medic: The drawback: couriers travel light. Without real armour you take 15% more damage from every hit.
街头医生: 代价是：信使都是轻装上阵。没有真正的护甲，你受到的每一次攻击伤害都增加15%。

Street Medic: You start with Civilian Hope +2. Shopkeepers and night workers remember the courier who always showed up; dispatchers across the city still know your route by heart.
街头医生: 你开局获得平民希望 +2。店主和夜班工人都记得那个从不爽约的信使；全城的调度员至今还能背出你的路线。

Street Medic: Ran games, debts and favours under paper lanterns.
街头医生: 在纸灯笼下面开赌局、收债、换人情。

Street Medic: Credits from takedowns, loot and gigs +35%
街头医生: 击倒、搜刮和委托获得的信用点 +35%
螺旋通缉度上升速度加快30%

Street Medic: You grew up under the paper lanterns of Lantern Row, running card games in the back of noodle bars and collecting debts for people who smiled too much. Everyone owed somebody, and you always knew who.
街头医生: 你在灯笼街的纸灯笼下长大，在面馆后屋开牌局，替那些笑得太多的人收债。每个人都欠着某个人，而你总是知道是谁。

Street Medic: Hustling taught you that every room has a price and every person has a story they want to hear. You can talk your way into a back office and out of a beating, usually in that order.
街头医生: 混街头教会了你：每个房间都有价码，每个人都有一个想听的故事。你能靠一张嘴混进后台办公室，也能靠一张嘴躲过一顿毒打——通常是按这个顺序。

Street Medic: You squeeze more out of everything: credits from takedowns, loot and gigs are 35% higher.
街头医生: 你能从一切东西里多榨出一点：击倒、搜刮和委托获得的信用点提高35%。

Street Medic: The drawback: Helix Civic Response has a long file on Lantern Row operators. Helix Heat builds 30% faster whenever you are spotted.
街头医生: 代价是：螺旋市政应对部对灯笼街的混混有一份很厚的档案。只要你被发现，螺旋通缉度上升速度就加快30%。

Street Medic: You start with Corporate Leverage −3 and Civilian Hope +2. Street vendors and fixers greet you like family; corporate offices see a hustler and lock the drawers.
街头医生: 你开局获得企业筹码 −3，平民希望 +2。街头小贩和中间人把你当家人；企业办公室看到一个混混，只会把抽屉锁上。

Street Medic: Lived half your life inside the city network.
街头医生: 有一半的人生活在城市网络里。
电磁脉冲消耗35点能量，而不是55点
破冰入侵的追踪时间延长40%

Street Medic: You were a signal ghost: a netrunner who slept in a pod and spent more hours in the city network than in your own body. You hid inside traffic feeds, advertising loops and municipal maintenance logs.
街头医生: 你曾是一个信号幽灵：一个睡在舱里的网络行者，待在城市网络里的时间比待在自己身体里还长。你藏身于交通信号、广告循环和市政维护日志之中。

Street Medic: The network taught you that everything is a signal waiting to be interrupted. You think in packets, timings and handshakes, and you hear electronics the way other people hear birds.
街头医生: 网络教会了你：一切都是等待被打断的信号。你用数据包、时序和握手来思考，你听电子设备的声音，就像别人听鸟叫。

Street Medic: Your EMP pulse costs 35 Energy instead of 55, and the trace on every ICE BREAK lasts 40% longer before it finds you.
街头医生: 你的电磁脉冲只消耗35点能量而不是55点，每一次破冰入侵的追踪也要多40%的时间才能找到你。

Street Medic: The drawback: your hands are slower than your mind. Physical weapon handling suffers and every reload takes 20% longer.
街头医生: 代价是：你的手比你的脑子慢。实体武器的操作会受影响，每一次装填都要多花20%的时间。

Street Medic: You start with AI Sympathy +6. ASCENSION fragments, maintenance drones and rogue programs will treat you as one of their own long before they trust anyone else.
街头医生: 你开局获得AI同情 +6。飞升的碎片、维护无人机和失控的程序，会比信任任何人都更早地把你当作自己人。
医疗包同时恢复30点能量。

Street Medic: ICE BREAK buffer holds one extra code.
街头医生: 破冰入侵缓冲区多容纳一个代码。
医疗包多恢复20点完整度。

Street Medic: Helix vetting and Lantern Row reputations cancel out: nobody would believe both stories.
街头医生: 螺旋的背景审查和灯笼街的名声会互相抵消：没有人会同时相信这两个故事。

Street Medic: Nightglass trains its recruits to hunt signal ghosts; the network would never have let you in.
街头医生: 夜玻璃训练新兵猎杀信号幽灵；网络永远不会让你进去。

Street Medic: Pick two. Who you were changes how you play, and how New Avalon treats you.
街头医生: 选择两个。你曾经是谁，决定了你怎么玩，也决定了新阿瓦隆怎么对待你。

Street Medic: In New Avalon your face is your only ID. Make it count.
街头医生: 在新阿瓦隆，你的脸就是你唯一的身份证明。好好设计。

Street Medic: How hard the city pushes back. You can review everything before you begin.
街头医生: 这座城市会怎样反击你。开始之前你可以检查所有设定。

Street Medic: Narrative focus. Enemies hit softly and are slow to notice you; operations can be skipped.
街头医生: 以剧情为主。敌人伤害低、发现你慢；行动可以跳过。

Street Medic: The intended balance between story and challenge.
街头医生: 剧情与挑战之间的预设平衡。

Street Medic: Enemies hit 50% harder, take more punishment and see further.
街头医生: 敌人伤害提高50%，更耐打，视野更远。

Street Medic: Neon Veins has a new character creator: eight backgrounds with real strengths and drawbacks, and a full appearance editor (skin tone, hair, eyes, cyberware).
街头医生: 《霓虹血脉》有了新的角色创建器：八种各有真实优势和代价的背景，以及完整的外貌编辑器（肤色、发型、眼睛、义体）。

Street Medic: Your progress is safe either way: chapter, choices, stats, side quests, weapons and credits all stay.
街头医生: 无论选哪一个，你的进度都是安全的：章节、选择、属性、支线任务、武器和信用点都会保留。

Street Medic: Your character carries over; you can remake them later from the Journal
街头医生: 你的角色会被保留；之后可以在日志中重新创建

Street Medic: Open the new creator, then continue exactly where you left off
街头医生: 打开新的创建器，然后从你离开的地方继续
已更新。你的进度会保留。
